Name: Azmaveth the Baharumite
Summary: Mighty man of David, called the Baharumite.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:33: Mighty man of David, called the Baharumite.
LifeLesson: The mention of Azmaveth in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
